dataset: Ward-level population, Census of India 2011 (BMC ward alphabet mapping)
source: Census of India 2011 primary source, collated to BMC ward alphabets by community project mickeykedia/Mumbai-Population-Map
license: Underlying Census of India data is public/open government data; the collation repo itself states no explicit license - attribute both Census of India 2011 and the compiling repo
download_date: NOT YET DOWNLOADED (raw.githubusercontent.com is blocked by this session's fetch tool per robots.txt, but is a normal public file - see scripts/download_population.sh which uses wget/curl)
format: CSV, 98 rows (sub-ward/ward level), full Primary Census Abstract schema (total population, male/female, literacy, worker categories, SC/ST, etc.)
crs: N/A (tabular, joins to ward boundary geometry via Ward_Alphabet field)
temporal_resolution: 2011 Census (most recent full Indian census; 2021 Census was postponed)
coverage: All Mumbai City + Mumbai Suburban census wards, grouped to BMC's 24 alphabetic wards
quality: high (primary Census source), but note: this is 2011 data, now 15 years old
limitations: No 2021/2024 census exists yet for India. Ward-to-census-ward mapping was done by the community maintainer per the DataMeet mailing list method documented in the repo README - verify the join before use.
processing: none - keep as retrieved; join to 01_city wards.geojson via Ward_Alphabet
notes: This satisfies the P1 population requirement at ward level. Gridded population (e.g. WorldPop 100m) was not pulled into this package - see notes below.

dataset: Gridded population (WorldPop, ~100m) - NOT downloaded, documented only
source_url: https://hub.worldpop.org/geodata/summary?id=49730 (India 2020 UN-adjusted constrained population count, 100m) - exact download URL should be confirmed on the WorldPop hub page as file paths change between releases
format: GeoTIFF, national (India), needs clipping to Mumbai bbox after download
coverage: national India raster - clip to Mumbai bbox locally
quality: high (WorldPop is a well-validated global product)
limitations: National file size is large; must be clipped locally. Not fetched in this session per the file-size/API-construction limits described in MISSING_DATA.md.
notes: Optional enhancement over the ward-level census data above; the task said ward-level is acceptable if gridded isn't readily available, so this was not blocking.
